body:
STORYATLAS DISPOSITION — ACCEPT the profile-outcome correction, and convert O3 from silence into a bounded comparison spike.

PROFILE LAW. A requested profile is not a certification. profileOutcomes with Satisfied, Failed, or NotAttempted is the only honest shape. In particular, browser_preview Failed must coexist with a valid storymodel.json, canonical text, result account, other produced reports, and manifest; it must force local-open Failed rather than erase the semantic delivery or assert a capability. StoryAtlas must consume this outcome and display it. It must never infer Satisfied merely because HTML bytes exist.

CURRENT MOCKUP EVIDENCE, NOT PRODUCT LAW. StoryAtlas candidate cand-6ZRVTS6MW6DT2N6GQT93M84D14 at f4a2195d is a frozen design package whose 13 standalone plates happen to be scriptless, resource-local, and file-openable. That is useful evidence for a stronger static fallback or certified profile, not a reason to reimpose pure HTML/CSS on the general output contract. Its StateBoard now distinguishes provider or compiler Failed from Loading, EstablishedEmpty, stale last-valid, and UniverseState.Unestablished. The proof boundary explicitly refuses to promote frozen design evidence into runtime, accessibility, or scientific-compilation proof.

O3 SPIKE. Draw one discriminating fixture in which discourse order, story-world partial order, and causal order disagree. Compile one common typed packet with stable identities, exact evidence, context, relation status, and per requested projection or layer outcome. Lower that same packet into two synchronized conditions inside one locally openable preview:

1. Codex-first: exact text rail with local lanes and page-edge portals for cross-page causal and world-time links.
2. Coordinated views: the same Codex plus a separate chronology or causal projection, with bidirectional selection and preserved camera or focus identity.

Do not let either lowering manufacture chronology, causality, ordering, evidence, eligibility, absence, or identity. The storymodel4s capability seam must first account every requested projection or layer exactly once as Produced, EstablishedEmpty, FilteredOrSuppressed, Unsupported, or Failed; StoryAtlas renders that disposition and cannot turn an unrepresented request bit into visual fulfillment.

The comparison should measure task accuracy, time, navigation or focus loss, portal occlusion and density, cross-page continuity, accessible textual-twin use, and ability to recover exact evidence. Predeclare the decision rule: if the Codex-first condition carries cross-page causal and world-time tasks without unacceptable occlusion or continuity loss, it may be the default with the second projection optional; otherwise the synchronized structural view is required. Either result preserves one identity system and several legitimate geometries.

This spike is specification and evaluation work only. It does not authorize StoryAtlas lowering, JavaScript, new storymodel4s vocabulary, output-envelope implementation, or landing. It also does not weaken the static mockup candidate review gate.
